definitions.explanation: A strong, lasting feeling of hatred or bitterness toward someone, often stemming from a perceived wrong. Frequently appears in news reporting about criminal motives.

examples.japanese: {怨恨|えんこん}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧。
examples.english: A crime motivated by a grudge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{怨恨|えんこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動機|どうき}→動機：16028_douki⟧とみて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The police believe resentment was the motive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる{怨恨|えんこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、ついに⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{起|お}こした→引き起こす：06165_hikiokosu⟧。
examples.english: Years of accumulated resentment finally led to this incident.

notes:
Compound noun: {怨|えん} (resentment) + {恨|こん} (grudge). A formal, literary word most often encountered in news reports discussing criminal motives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {怨恨|えんこん}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧ (a grudge-motivated crime)
- {怨恨|えんこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動機|どうき}→動機：16028_douki⟧ (resentment as the motive)
- {怨恨|えんこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧ (to harbor a grudge)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{恨|うら}み→恨み：00414_urami⟧: grudge, resentment — more common in everyday speech
- {怨恨|えんこん}: deeper, more formal term — often used in news and legal contexts
